notes: TMR Queensland design sheet (Q-series book / TC-series), colour drawing 'not to scale' with a lettered dimension table; every dimension from the sheet, AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheets give no letter widths, so there is no width check. Chain 15 / 27B / 15 / 27B / 15 / 27B / 15 / 27B / 15 / 27B / 15 = 225: cap tops 15, 57, 99, 141, 183. Word gaps measured from the sheet (SAT & SUN 10.6 / 10.6, XMAS DAY 13, GOOD FRIDAY 13.5, & ANZAC DAY 10.4 / 13.5). Green on white.
